Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
1)Can I bleed myself with any card that states "bleed any metuselah" (to
drop a Sabbat Threat counter for example)?

2)Masochism: can I add counter just for damage taken during combat or even
because of some specific cards (Force of will, Rutor's Hand, etc).
In this second case, how can I apply the superior version of the masochism
text?

3)Can I play Torn Signpost during the second round of combat?

Thanx

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Francois Villon" <federi...@libero.it> a écrit dans le message news:
p6hM6.3183$pa3.5...@news.infostrada.it...

> 1)Can I bleed myself with any card that states "bleed any metuselah" (to
> drop a Sabbat Threat counter for example)?

you can never bleed yourself. It's somewhere in the rulebook.

> 2)Masochism: can I add counter just for damage taken during combat or even
> because of some specific cards (Force of will, Rutor's Hand, etc).
> In this second case, how can I apply the superior version of the masochism
> text?

The second case. ignore superior effect since it's outside combat.

> 3)Can I play Torn Signpost during the second round of combat?

of course you can. Only a few cards must be played on first round only :
Trap, Weather control...

> Thanx
you're welcome =)

reyda
